_comment: Locale registry for thecompdesk.com — THE list. Codes MUST match the app exactly (zh-Hans / zh-Hant, never zh-CN / zh-TW), and the ORDER must match too: hreflang blocks and the picker both render in array order. ar and ur added 2026-07-27 (Phase 4C).
_lockstep: Three other lists have to agree with this one and none of them can be derived from it at run time: js/i18n-locale.js LOCALES (inline — the picker must render before any fetch resolves), the locale directories on disk, and the Google Fonts families below. scripts/i18n/verify.mjs reconciles all four and FAILS on divergence. That gate exists because the app shipped the identical defect twice: two hand-maintained font maps that had to agree, with nothing enforcing it, so adding ar/ur half-landed and the no-tofu check blamed the fonts.
_fonts: Families requested from the Google Fonts CDN, on top of DM Sans (Latin + Latin-ext only). 'Noto Sans' is on EVERY locale including English — it carries the arrow and fraction glyphs (U+2192, U+2190) that DM Sans lacks. Self-hosting is the APP's requirement, for cold offline launches; the site already loads DM Sans from the CDN and stays consistent with that Phase 3 decision.

locales._note: Urdu gets Nastaliq, not Naskh. Naskh is legible for Urdu but reads as wrong to a native speaker — the two are different scripts of the same writing system, not styles of one. Nastaliq also cascades each word diagonally downward, so its glyphs are far taller than the em box: see the ur block in css/i18n-fonts.css for the line-height floor that keeps single-line labels from clipping.

_draft: draft:true generates the locale's pages (so they can be previewed and audited) but keeps them OUT of every hreflang block and out of sitemap.xml. It exists because this repo's own rule — see hreflangBlock() in scripts/i18n/build-locales.mjs — is that an hreflang pointing at untranslated content is a duplicate-content signal STRICTLY WORSE than omission. ar and ur carry English copy until their catalogs land, so advertising them to Google would tell it we have 66 Arabic and Urdu pages that are in fact 66 more copies of the English ones. Remove the flag in the same commit that adds i18n/ar.json and i18n/ur.json.
